component.name: QR Code Generator
component.summary: Create polished QR codes with local generation and high-resolution export

description.p: QR Code Generator is an installable desktop app for creating polished QR codes for websites, WiFi, contacts, events, social profiles, app stores, and more without sending data to a server.
It provides live previews, multiple frame styles, dark and light themes, and exports up to 8K in PNG or SVG so the same design can work for screens, print, signage, and packaging.

ul.li: Create QR codes for 12 content types including URL, WiFi, event, social, and vCard.
Export PNG and SVG at resolutions from 1080p through 8K.
Customize the result with frames, themes, and real-time preview updates.

screenshot.caption: QR editing workspace with live preview and export controls.
QR content configuration with the preview updating in real time.
Frame customization and visual QR presentation options.
Additional export and design controls for polished QR output.

description.p: Initial release with 12 QR content types, frame styles, dark and light themes, and high-resolution PNG and SVG export.
